description: A very simple mailbox server-side mod for Minecraft.

releases.notes:
> [!NOTE]
> If you have 1.1, that version was bugged and this release was replaced with 1.1.1. Automatic mailbox repair was broken in 1.1. 

Changes:
- Updated to Minecraft 26.x 
- Fixed mailbox data not persisting across server restarts
- Added automatic repair: registrations for missing barrels are cleaned up each tick
- Added periodic scan (every 30s) to recover unregistered labeled barrels and discard orphaned labels

[![Fabric API](https://tipgrinder.com/images/fabric-api/requires-fabricapi.webp)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api/versions?g=1.21.10)

**Description:**  
Adds player-owned mailboxes to Minecraft, allowing players to send items to each over long distance.

**Features:**
- Players can place a **mailbox (barrel on a fence)**.
- Mailboxes are **personal and protected** from other players.
- Send items to other players using `/mailTo <username>`.
- **Mailbox labels** show owner and new mail notifications.
- Admin commands:
  - `/mailbox deleteNearest` – remove nearby mailbox.
  - `/mailbox inspect <player>` – view mailbox contents.
  - `/mailbox list` – list all mailboxes.
  - `/mailbox tp <player>` – teleport to a mailbox.
- Cooldown to prevent spam sending.
- Notifications when players receive mail.

**Notes:**
- Mail must be sent **in the same dimension**.
- Only **one mailbox per player**.
- Uses barrels + armor stands for visual labels.

**Screenshots:**
![Mailbox](https://github.com/yagmire/mailboxmod/blob/main/images/huge_2025-12-18_15.26.29.png?raw=true)
